relation_asset_check.finding: Both melancholy and melancholic are known lemmas; asset has no direct edge between them. knownForms permits one word-level derivational edge, and Analyze rejects an independently known form outside that set.
relation_asset_check.scope: Read-only bounded analysis of actual case 1; no validator or lexical asset changes; does not prove all dictionary derivations are covered.

evidence_retention.policy: Dedicated account only, private container tmpfs, maximum 50 bundles / 24 hours, no long-term complete raw export

limitations: Twenty stochastic samples are not a randomized controlled comparison or a long-term success guarantee.
75% refers to API generation validation success, not language-learning quality acceptance.
All errors are content validation failures, not evidence that every failure is model fault.
No cache/billing/reasoning token breakdown; do not infer actual cost or cache hit rates.
Validator package fingerprint covers AI source including prompts; its change alone is not a change to validation behavior.
Assistant exact token usage unknown; commands executed through tools, no subagent/model-switch claim.
